about_short_description.short_description: Unbabel is an IT company that helps businesses deliver multilingual customers thrive across cultures and geographies through AI.

product.name: Unbabel Language Operations Platform
product.description: A platform combining AI-powered machine translation with human post-editing to deliver multilingual translations tailored to business needs.

product.name: Post-Edited Machine Translation (PEMT)
product.description: A translation approach combining machine translation output with human post-editing to improve speed and maintain quality.

product.name: Kiwi AI Quality Estimation
product.description: An AI system that estimates the quality of machine translations to determine if human review is needed.

product.name: COMET Neural AI Evaluation System
product.description: A neural AI system that evaluates machine translation quality by comparing outputs to human-verified references.

product.name: Quality Intelligence API
product.description: An API providing access to Unbabel’s translation quality estimation models for integration into client systems.

product.name: Multilingual Workflow Integrations
product.description: Integrations that embed Unbabel’s translation capabilities into popular business applications and platforms.
